stations.title: Sacrae disciplinae leges promulgates the Code now in force

stations.instrument: Responsa ad proposita dubia, Pontificia Commissio Codici Iuris Canonici Authentice Interpretando, coetus plenarius 26 Iunii 1984

interpretation.answer: Affirmative to the first; negative to the second. A second reception, and no more.
interpretation.basis: Read in the Holy See's Latin collection Interpretationes Authenticae, sha256 1e7a0aaa..., at the block headed by this canon; the Dicastery for Legislative Texts serves the same Latin on its own page for this canon and the two were compared and found identical.
interpretation.question: Whether one who has already received the Eucharist may receive it again on the same day only once more, or as often as he takes part in the celebration of the Eucharist.
